description: Read a Housecall Pro estimate or invoice your contractor sent you — line items, totals, tax, what is still owed, the company behind it — from a shell with plain curl, instead of running the housecallpro-mcp server. Use when you want the data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed. Covers declining an option, and why approving cannot be scripted.
